0022600150.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-5, 0-3 on the road, 15th in the West) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (5-0, 1st in the West and 1st in the Southwest), who have won all five of their games, while the Kings sit 3.5 games back in the Pacific. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and Memphis has Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) and Ty Jerome (back soreness) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The Kings trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 123-112 at home on October 25, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
